question: Why does Doom have Tony Stark's face?
note: Robert Downey Jr. plays Victor von Doom. Nobody has said whether the film explains it.

options.label: He built the face on purpose
Someone else is under the mask

question: Which original Avenger turns up?
note: Doomsday is billed as the biggest cast Marvel has assembled. Reunions are the obvious lever.

question: How big is Wolverine's part?
note: Hugh Jackman is back in the fold after Deadpool & Wolverine.

question: Does Spider-Man appear?
note: Brand New Day lands months before Doomsday. Whether the timelines meet is the argument.

question: How many of the Fantastic Four are alive at the end?
note: First Steps put them on the board. Doom has a history with this family.

question: Does a named hero die on screen?
note: Every Avengers finale has taken someone. The question is how many.

question: Is Kang mentioned by name?
note: The Kang Dynasty became Doomsday. Whether the film acknowledges that is a real question.

question: Does Loki appear?
note: He is holding the branches of the multiverse together at the end of his own series.

question: Where does the film leave everyone?
note: Secret Wars follows in 2027, so the ending has to hand something over.

question: How many post-credits scenes?
note: Marvel has run zero, one and two. A handover film usually runs two.

question: Do the X-Men stay in the main universe?
note: Several Fox-era actors are on the cast list. Whether they stay is the whole point.

question: How openly is Secret Wars set up?
note: It is already dated. The only question is how loudly Doomsday says so.
